name: NYCU_QA
description: NYCU_QA is a question-answering dataset hosted on Hugging Face that contains QA pairs intended to evaluate reading comprehension and factual/question reasoning ability. It appears to include both multiple-choice and free-response style QA items spanning general topics. The dataset is intended for training and evaluating text-based QA models on accuracy and answer correctness.
reputation: A small, community-contributed QA dataset with limited visibility outside niche Hugging Face dataset users.
